svg.title: Notation Role in this paper G ⊆U(m) Given closed group and faithful matrix representation; r = dimR g is the color dimension. hN = d−1 N , Lp Physical fine mesh and physical period in the public family. ai, Li, ti Intermediate spacing, integer block ratio, and ti = log(a−1 i ). bβi, βi Prescribed reference clock and actual represented coupling; their com- parison is proved in the running argument. θ, θ Healthy-field thresholds; the local text specifies which schedule or fixed chart is being used.
